title: ConnectionPoolExhaustion in cart-microservice
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhaustion in the cart-microservice triggered by a traffic surge, where the default pool size of 40 was insufficient to handle concurrent requests.
verified_fix: Scaled the Redis connection pool size from 40 to 120 and increased the timeout duration to 60 seconds.
anti_pattern: Do not deploy services with static, low-size connection pools (e.g., 40) that do not account for traffic surges; ensure pool sizing and timeouts are load-tested against peak expected concurrency.
